title: Bull and Schwarz Digits put a joint AI stack on the roadmap
summary: Bull’s hardware plans and STACKIT cloud roles are distinct from a generally available integrated AI service.

# Bull and Schwarz Digits put a joint AI stack on the roadmap


By OpenTools Team


Their memorandum assigns hardware and cloud roles, while the proposed marketplace route remains prospective.


##


The planned combination


Bull’s[November 3 announcement](https://www.bull.com/en/press-releases/pr-bull-and-schwarz-digits-a-franco-german-alliance-for-europes-digital-sovereign) describes a memorandum of understanding with Schwarz Digits. Bull would contribute AI and high‑performance computing expertise, drawing on its Angers manufacturing site for servers; Schwarz Digits would bring STACKIT cloud infrastructure.


##


The procurement milestone


Partner responsibilities do not establish an orderable combined service. The[release](https://www.bull.com/en/press-releases/pr-bull-and-schwarz-digits-a-franco-german-alliance-for-europes-digital-sovereign) describes bringing BullSequana AI to STACKIT Marketplace in future tense, without giving a launch date. Server co‑design under Open Compute Project standards is also an intention. Procurement teams should distinguish those planned delivery routes from an available integrated stack.


Leonardo supercomputer inauguration, November 2022; archive HPC context, not the Bull–Schwarz Digits alliance.
